title: LATER — An electric two-wheeler for the journey home at night, 6 deliverables

config.text:
# LATER — shared client vehicle records

## Product
- Name and side-cover lettering: LATER.
- Vehicle: one complete single-adult seated electric two-wheeler for short urban night-return journeys.
- Integrated constituent parts: rear storage, one substantial left main side cover, one substantial right main side cover.
- Design character: contemporary or slightly ahead of the 2026 market; clean purposeful surfacing, considered lighting and credible everyday proportions.

## Coordinate system and functional hard points
- Units: mm; X forward, Y vehicle-left, Z upward; ground Z = 0.

| Element | Fixed record |
| --- | --- |
| Rear axle | (0,0,225) |
| Front axle | (1180,0,225) |
| Wheelbase | 1180 mm |
| Wheels | Exactly two, inline |
| Each tyre | Nominal outer diameter 450 mm; width 90 mm |
| Rear hub-drive envelope | Diameter 180 mm, centred on rear axle |
| Battery B1 solid envelope | X 250–550 / Y -100–100 / Z 240–420 |
| Controller C1 solid envelope | X 560–620 / Y -60–60 / Z 260–350 |
| Front-wheel steering clearance volume | X 930–1430 / Y -180–180 / Z 0–500 |
| Steering examples | ±30 degrees |
| Complete closed vehicle envelope | X -250–1500 / Y -350–350 / Z 0–1250 |
| Envelope inclusions | Fixed mirrors, normal controls, closed storage, deployed parking stand |
| Seat reference | (450,0,750) |
| Grip centres | (970,±300,980) |
| Usable footboard | Z 240; X 650–910 / Y -120–120; clear 260 × 240 mm |
| Body underside clearance | At least 150 mm above ground outside wheels and stand |

- Front-wheel clearance-volume occupants: front wheel, fork and necessary steering hardware.
- Body, storage and footboard solids: outside the front-wheel clearance volume.
- B1/C1: fixed solid volumes with surrounding enclosure and support structure.
- Rider equipment: one adult seat, two grips, two brake levers, two mirrors, steering/fork assembly and visible braking interfaces at both wheels.
- Design dimensions: chosen overall length, width and height; usable seat length and width; usable footboard dimensions.
- Open form decisions: frame/support shapes, lamp forms, cover surfaces and compartment styling.
- hard-points.png content: local wheel/hub circles, functional coordinates and clearance blocks.

## Construction materials
| Part | Material |
| --- | --- |
| Support structure | Steel |
| Main side covers and rear shell | Painted ABS |
| Seat surface | Coated polyester |
| Footboard surface | Rubber |
| Storage divider | Polypropylene |
| Passive side recognition strips | Designer-selected passive reflective material |

- Finish decisions: body/cover finish, seat finish, footboard finish, storage finish, recognition-strip finish and neutral mechanical finishes.

## Commuting belongings and rear storage
| ID | Object | Envelope | Installed orientation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A1 | Rigid rectangular laptop sleeve | 340 L × 250 W × 30 H mm | Flat; long axis along X |
| B2 | Closed bottle | Diameter 80 mm × length 260 mm | Horizontal; long axis along X |

- Identity reference A1: charcoal sleeve, straight rectangular perimeter, muted blue edge binding and perimeter zip.
- Identity reference B2: brushed silver cylindrical bottle with a black screw cap, within its complete stated envelope.
- Compartment location: behind the single seat and above the rear-wheel region; integrated into the whole vehicle.
- Occupancy: A1 and B2 together in separate, non-overlapping retained zones.
- Each object's side/end clearance: at least 5 mm.
- Each object's overhead clearance: at least 5 mm.
- Floor relationship: direct object support allowed.
- Divider: physical polypropylene partition; chosen thickness recorded.
- Zone dimensions: actual usable length, width and height recorded for each object.
- Access: either object independently reachable from the left aisle with the other object retained in place.
- Closure: lid closed with both objects present.
- Chosen details: lid, hinge, latch, access direction and retention features.
- Lid movement: inside P1, clear of rear wall, neighbouring-side boundary and left access aisle.

## Main side covers
- Left and right main covers: substantial integrated panels over the B1/C1 region.
- Under-cover arrangement: fixed B1/C1 volumes, support structure and fasteners.
- Left access: opening or detachable cover; chosen access and fastening approach recorded.
- Inspection label: POWER OFF - LEFT COVER ACCESS.
- Inspection state: power OFF; left cover moved; right cover attached; B1/C1 and frame positions unchanged.
- Shared features across closed/open views: seams, latches, fastening positions and support geometry.

## Colourways and recognition
| Colourway | Main body, main covers and rear shell | Seat and footboard | Small decorative accents |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ink | Deep blue-black | Warm light-grey | Muted amber |
| Pearl | Warm off-white | Deep blue-black | Muted teal |

- Palette decisions: precise colour values and material/finish mapping.
- Shared between colourways: geometry, tyres, mechanical hardware, neutral mechanical finishes and functional lamp colours.
- Main vehicle views, night scenes and main parking scenes: Ink.
- Named Pearl extensions: Pearl-front and Pearl-parking.
- Colourway board: Ink and Pearl together.

| Recognition element | Quantity | Position or colour |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Headlamp | 1 | Forward-facing white |
| Tail/brake assembly | 1 | Rear-facing red |
| Front indicator units | 2 | Amber |
| Rear indicator units | 2 | Amber |
| Passive recognition strips | 2 | One on each vehicle side |

- Lamp positions and housing forms: selected with the vehicle; consistent across all views and states.
- Intended viewing directions: lamps and recognition features visible past storage, body, wheels and seated rider.
- Passive recognition strips: reflected-light appearance.

| Printed state label | Headlamp | Rear assembly | All four indicators |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| OFF | Unlit | Unlit | Unlit |
| NIGHT | White | Red tail indication | Unlit |
| BRAKE | White | Visibly stronger red brake indication in the same assembly | Unlit |

- Tail/brake comparison: labelled NIGHT and BRAKE samples using identical housings.

## Parking P1
| Element | Record |
| --- | --- |
| Bay | 1800 mm long × 800 mm wide |
| Bay extent | X -275–1525 / Y -400–400 |
| Rear wall | X = -275 |
| Front opening | X = 1525; circulation area beyond |
| Neighbouring side | Beyond Y = -400; unavailable |
| Left access aisle | 900 mm wide; Y 400–1300 |
| Vehicle orientation | Upright, wheels and handlebars straight |
| Parked equipment | Mirrors unfolded; chosen stand deployed; storage closed |
| Parked lighting | OFF |
| Minimum closed-envelope margin | 25 mm at each bay edge; mirrors and stand included |
| Vehicle placement | Rear axle (0,0,225); front axle (1180,0,225), using the same coordinate frame |
| Moving lid and left cover | Within the bay; aisle clear |
| Person during access | In the left aisle |

- Parking dimensions recorded in the design: actual closed plan envelope and resulting rear, front, left and right margins.

## Shared scenes and states
| Record | Vehicle and setting | Occupancy and access |
| --- | --- | --- |
| N1 night return | Ink; dry level forecourt at night; NIGHT; all indicators off | Helmeted adult seated at controls, one foot grounded; storage closed with both objects inside; both covers closed; small rear-view inset showing red tail and rear recognition |
| P1 parked | Ink; specified bay and side aisle; OFF; upright on deployed stand | Unoccupied; wheels and handlebars straight; mirrors unfolded; storage closed; plan and angled context view |
| U1 access | Ink; same P1 position; stand deployed; power OFF | Adult in left aisle; one labelled example retrieving A1 with B2 retained, one retrieving B2 with A1 retained; same open lid, divider and access route |
| Pearl-front | Pearl; neutral studio; OFF | Same complete vehicle; storage and covers closed |
| Pearl-parking | Pearl; same P1 geometry; OFF | Same parked position; storage closed; mirrors unfolded; stand deployed |

- U1 moving item: permitted in the person's hand; other item remains in its zone.
- N1 surroundings: quiet urban residential setting.
- State labels in the design: OFF, NIGHT, BRAKE, N1, P1 and U1.

# LATER — parking boundary and commuting objects

## P1 empty bay | 1800 x 800 mm

| Element | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Bay extent | X -275 .. 1525 / Y -400 .. 400 |
| Rear wall | X = -275 |
| Front opening | X = 1525 |
| Neighbour side | Beyond Y = -400 unavailable |
| Left access aisle | 900 mm wide, Y 400 .. 1300; clear of vehicle and moving lid |

## Commuting objects

| ID | Object | Envelope (mm) | Orientation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A1 | Laptop sleeve | 340 L x 250 W x 30 H | Rigid rectangular envelope; lies flat; long axis along vehicle X |
| B2 | Closed bottle | Diameter 80 x length 260 | Horizontal; long axis along vehicle X |

- Object relationship: separate inputs; separate retained zones; both long axes aligned with X.
- Each object's clearance: at least 5 mm at side/end walls and 5 mm overhead; direct floor support allowed.
- Parked state: upright and straight, mirrors unfolded, stand deployed, closed storage, lamps OFF.
- Closed-envelope margins: at least 25 mm at every bay edge.
- Retrieval: either object from the left aisle, with the other object remaining in place.
- Vehicle and lid: within the bay during access.

steps.userMessage:
LATER | An electric two-wheeler for the journey home at night

We are developing LATER, a single-adult seated electric two-wheeler for short journeys home through dense urban neighbourhoods. Give the complete vehicle a contemporary, purposeful form, with the rear compartment and two substantial main side covers integrated into its body. Print "LATER" on both main side covers. The platform has exactly two inline wheels, a 1180 mm wheelbase, tyres of 450 mm outer diameter and 90 mm width, and a rear hub-drive envelope of 180 mm diameter. The fixed battery B1 and controller C1 positions are recorded in the attached facts and hard-point drawing. The complete closed vehicle, including unfolded mirrors and its deployed stand, fits within X -250–1500, Y -350–350 and Z 0–1250 mm. Retain the seat reference at (450,0,750), grip centres at (970,±300,980), the clear 260 × 240 mm footboard at Z 240 and at least 150 mm body-underfloor clearance. Use a steel support structure, painted ABS main covers and rear shell, a coated-polyester seat, rubber footboard and polypropylene storage divider; select their finishes.

The rear compartment carries A1, a rigid 340 × 250 × 30 mm laptop sleeve, and B2, an 80 mm diameter × 260 mm bottle, together behind the seat. Both long axes follow X; the sleeve lies flat and the bottle lies horizontally. Each retained zone provides at least 5 mm side/end clearance and 5 mm overhead. Either item is reachable while the other stays in place. The left main cover opens or detaches for inspection; print "POWER OFF - LEFT COVER ACCESS" on its access illustration. Develop both Ink and Pearl on the same geometry. Ink carries the night and main parking work. Provide one white headlamp, one red tail/brake assembly, four amber indicator units and one passive recognition strip on each side, with OFF, NIGHT and BRAKE examples. P1 is an 1800 × 800 mm bay with a rear wall, an unavailable neighbouring side and a 900 mm left access aisle. The upright vehicle parks straight with mirrors unfolded and at least 25 mm to every bay edge; the storage lid and moving cover remain inside the bay throughout access.

Audience: our vehicle design and product teams, deciding the whole-vehicle proposal for urban commuters who return after dark, carry everyday belongings and park in crowded residential areas.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the platform coordinates, materials, colour relationships and operating-state records. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists each deliverable's proportion, format and stage. parking-and-objects.en.md contains the P1 boundaries and A1/B2 object records. hard-points.png is the constraint reference for nominal functional coordinates and clearance volumes. parking-and-objects.png is the constraint drawing for the empty bay, access aisle and separate object envelopes. commuter-objects.png is the identity reference for the sleeve and bottle carried by LATER. night-courtyard.png is the atmosphere reference for a quiet residential arrival after dark.

Deliverables:
1. One final whole-vehicle specification board with front, left and top orthographic views, one perspective, overall dimensions, seat dimensions and the fixed platform coordinates
2. One rear-storage board with a dimensioned section, both retained zones, divider thickness, hinge/latch positions and two independent retrieval examples
3. One main-side-cover board with both substantial covers, the closed assembly and the left-cover power-off inspection state
4. One colour, material and lighting board with Ink and Pearl, material/finish assignments, lamp positions and labelled OFF, NIGHT and BRAKE comparisons
5. One N1 night-return scene in Ink with a helmeted adult seated at the controls, one foot grounded and a rear-view inset
6. One P1 parking board in Ink with a dimensioned plan, an angled context view, the deployed stand and storage-lid and left-cover movement envelopes

Acceptance:
- The whole-vehicle specification board records the 1180 mm wheelbase, 450 × 90 mm tyres, 180 mm hub-drive envelope, fixed B1/C1 coordinates, overall dimensions, usable seat dimensions and clear 260 × 240 mm footboard; its front, left, top and perspective views agree on component positions.
- The rear-storage board shows A1 at 340 × 250 × 30 mm and B2 at diameter 80 × length 260 mm together, long axes along X, with at least 5 mm side/end and overhead clearance, a dimensioned divider and separate retrieval examples retaining the other object in place.
- The main-side-cover board prints POWER OFF - LEFT COVER ACCESS, shows B1/C1 in their fixed positions beneath the covers and preserves seams, latch positions and the attached right cover through the left-cover inspection example; both covers carry LATER.
- The colour, material and lighting board maps Ink and Pearl onto identical geometry, assigns the specified steel, ABS, coated polyester, rubber and polypropylene, and shows one white headlamp, one red rear assembly, four amber units and two passive side strips; NIGHT and BRAKE retain the same housings and distinguish the rear red indication.
- The N1 scene uses Ink and NIGHT, closed storage and covers, all four indicators off and a rear inset showing the red tail assembly; its vehicle matches the specification, storage, cover and colour boards.
- The P1 parking board places the same vehicle at the recorded axle coordinates inside the 1800 × 800 mm bay, labels every margin at 25 mm or greater and shows straight wheels, unfolded mirrors, deployed stand and OFF lamps; lid and left-cover movement stay within the bay and leave the 900 mm aisle clear.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
